### 🚀 Feature Rationale
What problem does this feature solve? Is it related to zero-trust policy, AI runtime governance, or observability?

### 🏗️ Proposed Solution
A clear and concise description of the architecture and what you want to happen. 

### 💡 Alternatives Considered
A description of any alternative solutions or plugins you've considered.

### 📊 Enterprise Impact
How does this feature scale? Have you considered if it introduces any latency to the proxy layer?
